about: Hand-made podcast: a sponsor read, a long setup-payoff story, a short work story.

segments.text: Welcome back to the show, everybody.
Today I have my old roommate Dana with me.
Thanks for having me, this is going to be fun.
Before we start, this episode is sponsored by CloudVault.
CloudVault backs up your files every single night.
Use code SHOW for twenty percent off your first year.
Okay, so Dana, tell them about the apartment.
Our first apartment had the worst landlord in the city.
He would only ever call us at three in the morning.
One night he calls and says the basement is flooding.
So we run downstairs in our pajamas with buckets.
And it is not water, it is hundreds of tiny frogs.
Hundreds of frogs, hopping everywhere!
He had been breeding them down there for a science fair.
For his nephew's science fair, he said!
I still cannot hear a frog without laughing.
Anyway, we moved out three weeks later.
Let's talk about your new job though.
I started managing a bakery last spring.
The hardest part is waking up at four every day.
My first week I burned four hundred croissants.
The owner walked in and just stared at the oven.
Then she said, well, at least the smoke alarm works.
I almost quit right there.
But she kept me on, and now I run the place.
That is a great comeback story.
Alright, we are going to take a quick break.
